Capital Normal University | Beijing | Faculty/Professors in AI | ONSITE | Full-Time
The College of AI at CNU is hiring professors (Assistant to Full) in CV, NLP, and ML Theory. We offer competitive international salary + large multi-year research grants.
Location: Haidian District (near Baidu/ByteDance/MSRA).
Application: Send CV & 3-5 pubs to t116@cnu.edu.cn. No hard deadline.
